items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: And he was one of the singers. Monroe Powell.

ctx.x: We had one come back there and he went back to the Post Office, he got so mad and brought down, he went on back to the Post Office. And he was one of the singers. Monroe Powell. He was one of the singers. He was a nice looking boy, yellow, you know, and he had a lot of chicks all the time. So he married a Canadian girl. They had a child. So he finally moved to Seattle and stayed there, as far as I know of.
Yeah. You have some friends up there, right?
